0 # bat

A cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration.

## Key Features ### Syntax highlighting `bat` supports syntax highlighting for a large number of programming and markup languages. ### Git integration `bat` communicates with `git` to show modifications with respect to the index. ### Show non-printable characters You can use the `-A`/`--show-all` option to show and highlight non-printable characters. ### Automatic paging By default, `bat` pipes its own output to a pager (e.g. `less`) if the output is too large for one screen. If you would rather `bat` work like `cat` all the time (never page output), you can set `--paging=never` as an option, either on the command line or in your configuration file. If you intend to alias `cat` to `bat` in your shell configuration, you can use `alias cat='bat --paging=never'` to preserve the default behavior. #### File concatenation Even with a pager set, you can still use `bat` to concatenate files. Whenever `bat` detects a non-interactive terminal (i.e. when you pipe into another process or into a file), `bat` will act as a drop-in replacement for `cat` and fall back to printing the plain file contents, regardless of the `--pager` option's value. ## How to use Display a single file on the terminal: ```bash bat README.md ``` Display multiple files at once: ```bash bat src/*.rs ``` Read from stdin, determine the syntax automatically: ```bash curl -s https://sh.rustup.rs | bat ``` Read from stdin, specify the language explicitly: ```bash yaml2json .travis.yml | json_pp | bat -l json ``` Show and highlight non-printable characters: ```bash bat -A /etc/hosts ``` Use it as a `cat` replacement: ```bash bat > note.md # quickly create a new file bat header.md content.md footer.md > document.md bat -n main.rs # show line numbers (only) bat f - g # output 'f', then stdin, then 'g'. ``` ### Integration with other tools #### `fzf` You can use `bat` as a previewer for `fzf`: ```bash fzf --preview "bat --color=always --style=numbers --line-range=:500 {}" ``` #### `find` or `fd` Preview all search results with `bat`: ```bash find … -exec bat {} + fd … -X bat ``` #### `ripgrep` With `batgrep`, `bat` can be used as the printer for `ripgrep` search results: ```bash batgrep needle src/ ``` #### `tail -f` `bat` can be combined with `tail -f` to continuously monitor a given file with syntax highlighting: ```bash tail -f /var/log/pacman.log | bat --paging=never -l log ``` #### `git` Combine `bat` with `git show` to view an older version of a file with syntax highlighting: ```bash git show v0.6.0:src/main.rs | bat -l rs ``` #### `git diff` Combine `bat` with `git diff` to view lines around code changes: ```bash batdiff() { git diff --name-only --relative --diff-filter=d -z | xargs -0 bat --diff } ``` #### `xclip` Pipe the output into `xclip` to copy file contents: ```bash bat main.cpp | xclip ``` `bat` will detect that the output is being redirected and print the plain file contents. #### `man` `bat` can be used as a colorizing pager for `man`: ```bash export MANPAGER="bat -plman" man 2 select ``` #### Highlighting `--help` messages You can use `bat` to colorize help text: ```bash cp --help | bat -plhelp ``` Or use a wrapper: ```bash alias bathelp='bat --plain --language=help' help() { "$@" --help 2>&1 | bathelp } ``` ## Installation Download prebuilt binaries from the release page for your platform. `bat` is also available through various package managers: - Ubuntu/Debian: `sudo apt install bat` - Alpine: `apk add bat` - Arch: `pacman -S bat` - Fedora: `dnf install bat` - Gentoo: `emerge sys-apps/bat` - FreeBSD: `pkg install bat` - OpenBSD: `pkg_add bat` - Nix: `nix-env -i bat` - openSUSE: `zypper install bat` - macOS (Homebrew): `brew install bat` - macOS (MacPorts): `port install bat` - Windows (WinGet): `winget install sharkdp.bat` - Windows (Chocolatey): `choco install bat` - Windows (Scoop): `scoop install bat` ## Customization ### Highlighting theme Use `bat --list-themes` to get a list of all available themes for syntax highlighting. To select a theme, use the `--theme` option: ```bash bat --theme=TwoDark myfile.txt ``` Or set the `BAT_THEME` environment variable: ```bash export BAT_THEME="TwoDark" ``` `bat` automatically picks a fitting theme depending on your terminal's background color. You can use the `--theme-dark` / `--theme-light` options or the `BAT_THEME_DARK` / `BAT_THEME_LIGHT` environment variables to customize the themes used. ### Output style Use the `--style` option to control the appearance of `bat`'s output: ```bash bat --style=numbers,changes myfile.txt ``` Set the `BAT_STYLE` environment variable to make these changes permanent. ### Decorations By default, `bat` only shows decorations when outputting to an interactive terminal. Control this with the `--decorations` option: ```bash bat --decorations=always myfile.txt # always show decorations bat --decorations=never myfile.txt # never show decorations ``` ### Using a different pager `bat` uses the pager specified in the `PAGER` environment variable. If not set, `less` is used by default. You can also use bat's built-in pager with `--pager=builtin`. To use a different pager: ```bash export BAT_PAGER="less -RF" ``` ### Configuration file `bat` can be customized with a configuration file. To get the default path: ```bash bat --config-file ``` Generate a default configuration file: ```bash bat --generate-config-file ``` The configuration file is a simple list of command line arguments. Example: ```bash # Set the theme --theme="TwoDark" # Show line numbers, Git modifications and file header --style="numbers,changes,header" # Use C++ syntax for Arduino .ino files --map-syntax "*.ino:C++" ``` ## Command-line options For a full list of options, run: ```bash bat --help ``` ## Project goals `bat` tries to achieve the following goals: - Provide beautiful, advanced syntax highlighting - Integrate with Git to show file modifications - Be a drop-in replacement for (POSIX) `cat` - Offer a user-friendly command-line interface ## License Copyright (c) 2018-2025 bat-developers `bat` is made available under the terms of either the MIT License or the Apache License 2.0, at your option. use clap::{Arg, ArgAction, ArgGroup, Command, ValueHint, builder::PossibleValue};

static VERSION: &str = "0.26.1 (4dd824a)";

pub fn build_app(interactive_output: bool) -> Command {
    let color_when = if interactive_output {
        clap::ColorChoice::Auto
    } else {
        clap::ColorChoice::Never
    };

    let mut app = Command::new("bat")
        .version(VERSION)
        .color(color_when)
        .disable_help_flag(true)
        .disable_help_subcommand(true)
        .args_conflicts_with_subcommands(true)
        .about("A cat(1) clone with wings.")
        .long_about("A cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration.")
        .term_width(100)
        .after_long_help(
            "You can use 'bat cache' to customize syntaxes and themes. See 'bat cache --help' for more \
             information",
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("FILE")
                .help("File(s) to print / concatenate. Use '-' for standard input.")
                .long_help(
                    "File(s) to print / concatenate. Use a dash ('-') or no argument at all to read from \
                     standard input.",
                )
                .num_args(1..)
                .value_hint(ValueHint::FilePath),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("show-all")
                .long("show-all")
                .short('A')
                .action(ArgAction::SetTrue)

import subprocess, os, sys, re
def probe(scopes, args, infile, syntax_arg=None, text=None):
    head = open('src1/themes/Probe.tmTheme').read().split('</array>')[0].replace('Probe','SP').replace('#123456','#010101')
    rules = ''
    for i, s in enumerate(scopes):
        col = '#%02X%02X%02X' % ((i+2)>>8, (i+2)&255, 0)
        rules += '\t\t<dict><key>scope</key><string>%s</string><key>settings</key><dict><key>foreground</key><string>%s</string></dict></dict>\n' % (s, col)
    os.makedirs('src5/themes', exist_ok=True)
    for f in os.listdir('src5/themes'): os.remove('src5/themes/'+f)
    open('src5/themes/SP.tmTheme','w').write(head + rules + '\t</array>\n</dict>\n</plist>\n')
    subprocess.run(['./mybat','cache','--build','--source','src5','--target','src5/cache'], capture_output=True)
    env = dict(os.environ); env['BAT_CACHE_PATH']='src5/cache'; env['COLORTERM']='truecolor'
    out = subprocess.run(['./mybat','--theme=SP','-f','-p'] + args + [infile], env=env, capture_output=True).stdout.decode()
    res = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[0m', out):
        r,g,b,txt = int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3)),m.group(4)
        if (r,g,b)==(1,1,1): res.append((txt,'<default>'))
        else:
            idx = (r<<8|g)-2
            res.append((txt, scopes[idx] if 0<=idx<len(scopes) else '?%d'%idx))
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    scopes = sys.argv[1].split(',')
    infile = sys.argv[2]
    args = sys.argv[3:]
    for t,s in probe(scopes, args, infile): print(repr(t), s)
EOF

%YAML 1.2
---
name: Markdown
file_extensions:
  - md
  - mdown
  - markdown
  - markdn
scope: text.html.markdown
variables:

  html_block_tag: '(?i:address|article|aside|blockquote|body|center|dd|details|dialog|dir|div|dl|dt|fieldset|figcaption|figure|footer|form|frameset|h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|head|header|hgroup|hr|html|iframe|legend|li|link|main|menu|nav|noframes|ol|optgroup|option|p|param|pre|section|summary|table|tbody|td|tfoot|th|thead|title|tr|ul|script|style)'
  lang_rust: '(?i:rust|rs)'
  lang_python: '(?i:python|py|py3|python3)'
  lang_shell: '(?i:shell|sh|bash|zsh|console|shell-script|ksh)'
  lang_json: '(?i:json|jsonc|json5)'
  lang_yaml: '(?i:yaml|yml)'
  lang_toml: '(?i:toml)'
  lang_c: '(?i:c|h)'
  lang_cpp: '(?i:cpp|c\+\+|cxx|cc|hpp)'
  lang_js: '(?i:js|javascript|jsx|mjs|cjs)'
  lang_html: '(?i:html|htm)'
  lang_css: '(?i:css)'
  lang_xml: '(?i:xml|svg)'
  lang_go: '(?i:go|golang)'
  lang_java: '(?i:java)'
  lang_diff: '(?i:diff|patch)'
  lang_ini: '(?i:ini|cfg|conf)'
  lang_makefile: '(?i:makefile|make|mk)'
  lang_sql: '(?i:sql)'
  lang_dockerfile: '(?i:dockerfile|docker)'
contexts:
  main:
    - include: block-level

  block-level:
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
    - include: fenced-code-blocks
    - include: atx-heading
    - include: thematic-break
    - include: block-quote
    - include: indented-code-block
    - include: list-unnumbered
    - include: list-numbered
    - include: link-reference-def
    - include: html-block
    - include: table
    - match: '^(?=\S)'
      push: paragraph
    - match: '^\s+(?=\S)'
      push: paragraph

  # --- Headings ---------------------------------------------------------
  atx-heading:
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{6})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.6.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{5})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.5.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{4})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.4.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{3})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.3.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{2})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.2.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{1})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.1.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{1,6})[ \t]*$\n?'
      scope: markup.heading.markdown
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
  heading-content:
    - meta_content_scope: entity.name.section.markdown
    - match: '[ \t]+(#+)?[ \t]*$\n?'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.end.markdown
      pop: true
    - match: '$\n?'
      pop: true
    - include: inline

  # --- Thematic break -----------------------------------------------------
  thematic-break:
    - match: '^{{thematic_break}}\n?'
      scope: meta.separator.thematic-break.markdown punctuation.definition.thematic-break.markdown

  # --- Block quote --------------------------------------------------------
  block-quote:
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(>)[ ]?'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.quote.markdown
        - match: '^\s*$\n?'
          pop: true
        - match: '^[ ]{,3}(>)[ ]?'
          captures:
            1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
        - match: '(>)[ ]?'
          captures:
            1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
        - include: fenced-code-blocks
        - include: atx-heading
        - include: thematic-break
        - include: list-unnumbered
        - include: list-numbered
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          push:
            - match: '$\n?'
              pop: true
            - include: inline

  # --- Indented code ------------------------------------------------------
  indented-code-block:
    - match: '^{{indented_code_block}}.*\n?'
      scope: markup.raw.block.markdown

  # --- Lists --------------------------------------------------------------
  list-unnumbered:
    - match: '^[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-unnumbered-content
  list-unnumbered-content:
    - meta_scope: markup.list.unnumbered.markdown
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
      pop: true
    - match: '[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - match: '[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - include: fenced-code-blocks
    - include: atx-heading
    - include: block-quote
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      push: list-paragraph
  list-numbered:
    - match: '^[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-numbered-content
  list-numbered-content:
    - meta_scope: markup.list.numbered.markdown
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
      pop: true
    - match: '[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - match: '[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - include: fenced-code-blocks
    - include: atx-heading
    - include: block-quote
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      push: list-paragraph
  list-paragraph:
    - meta_scope: meta.paragraph.list.markdown
    - match: '^(?=\s*$)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=\s+(?:[*+-]|\d+[.)])\s)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}#{1,6}\s)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=\s*{{fence_start}})'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?={{thematic_break}})'
      pop: true
    - match: '^[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
    - match: '^[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
    - match: '^[ \t]*'
      set: list-paragraph
    - include: inline

  # --- Paragraph ----------------------------------------------------------
  paragraph:
    - meta_scope: meta.paragraph.markdown
    - match: '^(?=\s*$)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(=+)[ \t]*$\n?'
      scope: markup.heading.1.setext.markdown punctuation.definition.heading.setext.markdown
      pop: true
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(-+)[ \t]*$\n?'
      scope: markup.heading.2.setext.markdown punctuation.definition.heading.setext.markdown
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}#{1,6}\s)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}#{1,6}$)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=\s*{{fence_start}})'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?={{thematic_break}})'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}>)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}(?:[*+-]|\d+[.)])\s)'
      pop: true
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}</?{{html_block_tag}}(?:\s|/?>))'
      pop: true
    - match: '^[ \t]*'
      set: paragraph
    - include: inline

  # --- HTML blocks ----------------------------------------------------------
  html-block:
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}</?{{html_block_tag}}(?:\s|/?>))'
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.disable-markdown
        - match: '^\s*$\n?'
          pop: true
        - include: scope:text.html.basic
    - match: '^(?=[ ]{,3}<!--)'
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.disable-markdown
        - match: '^\s*$\n?'
          pop: true
        - include: scope:text.html.basic

  # --- Tables ---------------------------------------------------------------
  table:
    - match: '^(?=\|)'
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.table.markdown-gfm
        - match: '^\s*$\n?'
          pop: true
        - match: '^(?![ ]*\|)'
          pop: true
        - match: '\|'
          scope: punctuation.separator.table-cell.markdown-gfm
        - match: '[ ]*:?-+:?[ ]*(?=\|)'
          scope: punctuation.definition.table-cell.markdown-gfm
        - include: inline

  # --- Link reference definitions -------------------------------------------
  link-reference-def:
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(\[)([^\]]+)(\])(:)[ \t]*'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.constant.begin.markdown
        2: constant.other.reference.link.markdown
        3: punctuation.definition.constant.end.markdown
        4: punctuation.separator.key-value.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.link.reference.def.markdown
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true
        - match: '(<)([^>]*)(>)'
          captures:
            1: punctuation.definition.link.begin.markdown
            2: markup.underline.link.markdown
            3: punctuation.definition.link.end.markdown
        - match: '\S+'
          scope: markup.underline.link.markdown
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.link.reference.def.markdown
            - match: '$\n?'
              pop: true
            - include: link-title

  link-title:
    - match: '[ \t]*(")'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.other.link.description.title.markdown
        - match: '"'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.markdown
          pop: true
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true
    - match: "[ \\t]*(')"
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.other.link.description.title.markdown
        - match: "'"
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.markdown
          pop: true
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true
    - match: '[ \t]*(\()'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.other.link.description.title.markdown
        - match: '\)'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.markdown
          pop: true
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true

  # --- Fenced code blocks -----------------------------------------------------
  fenced-code-blocks:
    - include: fenced-rust
    - include: fenced-python
    - include: fenced-shell
    - include: fenced-json
    - include: fenced-yaml
    - include: fenced-toml
    - include: fenced-c
    - include: fenced-cpp
    - include: fenced-js
    - include: fenced-html
    - include: fenced-css
    - include: fenced-xml
    - include: fenced-go
    - include: fenced-java
    - include: fenced-diff
    - include: fenced-ini

%YAML 1.2
---
name: Markdown
file_extensions:
  - md
  - mdown
  - markdown
  - markdn
scope: text.html.markdown
variables:
  block_quote: '(?:[ ]{,3}>(?:.|$))'
  indented_code_block: '(?:[ ]{4}|\t)'
  atx_heading: '(?:[#]{1,6}\s*)'
  list_item: '(?:[ ]{,3}(?:[*+-]|\d+[.)])(?=\s))'

  lang_rust: '(?i:rust|rs)'
  lang_python: '(?i:python|py|py3|python3)'
  lang_shell: '(?i:shell|sh|bash|zsh|console|shell-script|ksh)'
  lang_json: '(?i:json|jsonc|json5)'
  lang_yaml: '(?i:yaml|yml)'
  lang_toml: '(?i:toml)'
  lang_c: '(?i:c|h)'
  lang_cpp: '(?i:cpp|c\+\+|cxx|cc|hpp)'
  lang_js: '(?i:js|javascript|jsx|mjs|cjs)'
  lang_html: '(?i:html|htm)'
  lang_css: '(?i:css)'
  lang_xml: '(?i:xml|svg)'
  lang_go: '(?i:go|golang)'
  lang_java: '(?i:java)'
  lang_diff: '(?i:diff|patch)'
  lang_ini: '(?i:ini|cfg|conf)'
  lang_makefile: '(?i:makefile|make|mk)'
  lang_sql: '(?i:sql)'
  lang_dockerfile: '(?i:dockerfile|docker)'
contexts:
  main:
    - include: block-level

  block-level:
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
    - include: fenced-code-blocks
    - include: atx-heading
    - include: thematic-break
    - include: block-quote
    - include: indented-code-block
    - include: list-unnumbered
    - include: list-numbered
    - include: link-reference-def
    - include: html-block
    - include: table
    - match: '^(?=\S)'

    - match: '^\s+(?=\S)'
      push: paragraph

  atx-heading:
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{6})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.6.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{5})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.5.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{4})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.4.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{3})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.3.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{2})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.2.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{1})(?!#)[ \t]*(?=\S)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.heading.1.markdown
        - include: heading-content
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(#{1,6})[ \t]*$\n?'
      scope: markup.heading.markdown
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.begin.markdown
  heading-content:
    - meta_content_scope: entity.name.section.markdown
    - match: '[ \t]+(#+)?[ \t]*$\n?'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.heading.end.markdown
      pop: true
    - match: '$\n?'
      pop: true
    - include: inline

  # --- Thematic break -----------------------------------------------------
  thematic-break:
    - match: '^{{thematic_break}}\n?'
      scope: meta.separator.thematic-break.markdown punctuation.definition.thematic-break.markdown

  # --- Block quote --------------------------------------------------------
  block-quote:
    - match: '^[ ]{,3}(>)[ ]?'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
      push:
        - meta_scope: markup.quote.markdown
        - match: '^\s*$\n?'
          pop: true
        - match: '^[ ]{,3}(>)[ ]?'
          captures:
            1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
        - match: '(>)[ ]?'
          captures:
            1: punctuation.definition.blockquote.markdown
        - include: fenced-code-blocks
        - include: atx-heading
        - include: thematic-break
        - include: list-unnumbered
        - include: list-numbered

    - match: '^{{indented_code_block}}.*\n?'

  # --- Lists --------------------------------------------------------------

    - match: '^[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'

        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown

  list-unnumbered-content:
    - meta_scope: markup.list.unnumbered.markdown
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
      pop: true
    - match: '[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.unnumbered.bullet.markdown punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - match: '[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - include: fenced-code-blocks
    - include: atx-heading
    - include: block-quote
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      push: list-paragraph
  list-numbered:
    - match: '^[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-numbered-content
  list-numbered-content:
    - meta_scope: markup.list.numbered.markdown
    - match: '^\s*$\n?'
      pop: true
    - match: '[ ]*(\d+)([.)])(?=\s)'
      captures:
        1: markup.list.numbered.bullet.markdown
        2: punctuation.definition.list_item.markdown
      push: list-paragraph
    - match: '[ ]*([*+-])(?=\s)'

      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.block.rust
        - match: '\}'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: statements

  expressions:
    - include: strings
    - include: chars
    - include: numbers
    - include: keywords
    - include: let
    - include: closure
    - include: macros
    - include: types
    - include: operators
    - include: method-call
    - include: function-call
    - include: lifetimes
    - include: group
    - include: brackets
    - match: '\b(self)\b'
      scope: variable.language.rust
    - match: '\b(super|crate)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*::)'
      captures:
        1: meta.path.rust
    - match: '::'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
    - match: '\.'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.dot.rust
      push:
        - match: '([0-9]+)'
          captures:
            1: constant.numeric.integer.decimal.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*\()'
          captures:
            1: support.function.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(await)\b'
          scope: keyword.control.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
          pop: true
        - match: ''
          pop: true
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust

  group:
    - match: '\('
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
        - match: '\)'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: expressions
        - include: block
  brackets:
    - match: '\['
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
        - match: '\]'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: ';'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - include: expressions
        - include: block

  keywords:
    - match: '\b(if|else|for|in|while|loop|match|return|break|continue|yield|await)\b'
      scope: keyword.control.rust
    - match: '\b(as)\b'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\b(mut|const|static|ref|move|unsafe|async|dyn|where|default)\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.rust
    - match: '\b(true|false)\b'
      scope: constant.language.rust
    - match: '\b(impl)\b'
      scope: storage.type.impl.rust
    - match: '\b(fn)\b'
      scope: storage.type.function.rust
      push: fn-definition

  let:
    - match: '\b(let)\b'
      scope: storage.type.rust
      push:
        - match: '(?=[;=:])'
          pop: true
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          set:
            - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*=\s*\|)'
              captures:
                1: entity.name.function.rust
              pop: true
            - match: '(?=[;=:])'
              pop: true
            - match: '\b(mut|ref)\b'
              scope: storage.modifier.rust
            - include: group
            - include: brackets
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
            - match: '\b(self)\b'
              scope: variable.language.rust
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '(?=\S)'
              pop: true

  closure:
    - match: '(\|)(?=[^|]*\|)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.parameters.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.closure.rust
        - match: '\|'
          scope: punctuation.definition.parameters.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(mut|ref)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '({{identifier}})'
          captures:
            1: variable.parameter.rust
        - match: ':'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
          push:
            - match: '(?=[,|])'
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: ','
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust

  macros:
    - match: '({{identifier}})(!)(?=\s*[\(\[\{])'
      scope: support.macro.rust

  method-call: []

  function-call:
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*\()'
      captures:
        1: meta.function-call.rust

  types:
    - match: '\b{{primitives}}\b'
      scope: storage.type.rust
    - match: '\b(Vec|String|Option|Result|Box|Rc|Arc|HashMap|HashSet|BTreeMap|BTreeSet|VecDeque|Some|None|Ok|Err|Copy|Clone|Debug|Default|Send|Sync|Sized|Iterator|IntoIterator|Fn|FnMut|FnOnce|Drop|PartialEq|Eq|PartialOrd|Ord|Hash|From|Into|AsRef|AsMut|Display|Error|ToString|Cell|RefCell|Mutex|RwLock|Path|PathBuf|Cow|Pin|Future|Write|Read|BufRead|Deref|DerefMut|Borrow|TryFrom|TryInto|ToOwned|Any|Unpin)\b'
      scope: support.type.rust
    - match: '<'
      scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
        - match: '>'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - include: numbers
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\b(fn)\b'
          scope: storage.type.function.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '{{identifier}}'

  type-punctuation:
    - match: '::'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '[&*]'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\+'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '='
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust

  lifetimes:
    - match: '{{lifetime}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.lifetime.rust

  operators:
    - match: '=>'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\b_\b'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '(?:\+|-|\*|/|%|\^|&|\||<<|>>)='
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
    - match: '=='
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '!='
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '(?<![-=<>])=(?![=>])'
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
    - match: '&&|\|\|'
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.rust
    - match: '!'
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.rust
    - match: '<=|>=|<|>'
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '\.\.=?'
      scope: keyword.operator.range.rust
    - match: '\+|-|\*|/|%'
      scope: keyword.operator.arithmetic.rust
    - match: '&|\||\^|<<|>>'
      scope: keyword.operator.bitwise.rust
    - match: '\?'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '@'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust

  numbers:
    - match: '\b({{dec_literal}})(\.)(?!\.|[A-Za-z_])'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push:
        - match: '[0-9][0-9_]*(?:{{float_exponent}})?'
          scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
          set:
            - match: '{{float_suffixes}}'
              scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
              pop: true
            - match: ''
              pop: true
        - match: ''
          pop: true
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}{{float_exponent}}'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push: float-suffix
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}(?={{float_suffixes}})'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push: float-suffix
    - match: '\b0x[0-9a-fA-F_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.hexadecimal.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b0o[0-7_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.octal.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b0b[01_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.binary.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.decimal.rust
      push: int-suffix
  int-suffix:
    - match: '{{int_suffixes}}'
      scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
      pop: true
    - match: ''
      pop: true
  float-suffix:
    - match: '{{float_suffixes}}'
      scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
      pop: true
    - match: ''
      pop: true

  chars:
    - match: '(b)?('')(?:{{escaped_byte}}|[^''\\])('')'
      scope: string.quoted.single.rust
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        3: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
    - match: '('')(?:{{escaped_char}}|[^''\\])('')'
      scope: string.quoted.single.rust
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust

  strings:
    - match: '(b)?(r)(#*)(")'
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: storage.type.string.rust
        3: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        4: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.quoted.double.raw.rust
        - match: '"\3'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: format-placeholders
    - match: '(b)?(")'
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.quoted.double.rust
        - match: '"'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '{{escaped_char}}'
          scope: constant.character.escape.rust
        - match: '\\\n'
          scope: constant.character.escape.rust
        - include: format-placeholders
  format-placeholders:
    - match: '\{\{|\}\}'
      scope: constant.character.escape.rust
    - match: '\{[^{}"]*\}'
      scope: constant.other.placeholder.rust

  # ---- definitions ----
  fn-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.function.rust
      set: fn-after-name
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true
  fn-after-name:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '<'
      scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
        - match: '>'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\('
      scope: punctuation.section.parameters.begin.rust
      set: fn-parameters
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true
  fn-parameters:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.parameters.rust
    - match: '\)'
      scope: punctuation.section.parameters.end.rust
      set: fn-return
    - match: '\b(mut)\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.rust
    - match: '&'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '{{lifetime}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.lifetime.rust
    - match: '\b(self)\b'
      scope: variable.parameter.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:(?!:))'
      captures:
        1: variable.parameter.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.parameters.rust
        - match: '(?=[,)])'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '\['
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\]'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: numbers
            - match: ';'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - include: group
  fn-return:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
      push:
        - meta_content_scope: meta.function.return-type.rust
        - match: '(?=\{|;|\bwhere\b)'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '\['
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\]'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: numbers
            - match: ';'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\b(where)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
      push:
        - match: '(?=\{|;)'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\{'
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.rust meta.block.rust
        - match: '\}'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: statements
    - match: ';'
      scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
      pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  struct-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.struct.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: '\b(where)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: visibility
            - include: attribute
            - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:)'
              captures:
                1: variable.other.member.rust
            - match: ':'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
              push:
                - match: '(?=[,}])'
                  pop: true
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - include: lifetimes
                - include: group
                - include: brackets
                - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
                  scope: storage.modifier.rust
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              set:
                - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
                - match: ';'
                  scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
                  pop: true
                - match: '(?=\S)'
                  pop: true
            - include: visibility
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: ';'
          scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  enum-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.enum.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: attribute
            - match: '\('
              scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
              push:
                - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
                - match: '\)'
                  scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
                  pop: true
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - include: lifetimes
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '\{'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
              push:
                - meta_scope: meta.block.rust
                - match: '\}'
                  scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
                  pop: true
                - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:)'
                  captures:
                    1: variable.other.member.rust
                - match: ':'
                  scope: punctuation.separator.rust
                - match: ','
                  scope: punctuation.separator.rust
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '='
              scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
            - include: numbers
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  trait-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.trait.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: ':'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
          push:
            - match: '(?=\{|\bwhere\b)'
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '({{identifier}})'
              captures:
                1: entity.other.inherited-class.rust
        - match: '\b(where)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: statements
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  impl-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.impl.rust
    - match: '<'
      scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
        - match: '>'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\b(for)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.impl.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set: impl-body
        - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*[<{]|\s*$|\s+where)'
          captures:
            1: entity.name.impl.rust
        - match: '\b(where)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\{'
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
      set: impl-body
    - match: '\b(where)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
    - match: '!'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\b{{primitives}}\b(?=\s*(?:\{|for\b))'
      scope: storage.type.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\s*(?:\{|for\b))'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.impl.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\s*$)'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.impl.rust
    - include: types
    - include: type-punctuation
    - include: lifetimes
    - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '(?=;)'
      pop: true
  impl-body:
    - meta_scope: meta.impl.rust meta.block.rust
    - match: '\}'
      scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
      pop: true
    - include: statements
EOF

cd /workspace && cat > assets/syntaxes/rust.sublime-syntax <<'EOF'
%YAML 1.2
---
name: Rust
file_extensions:
  - rs
scope: source.rust
variables:
  identifier: '(?:(?:r\#)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)'
  camel_ident: '\b_*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*\b'
  lifetime: '''[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?!'')'
  escaped_byte: '\\([nrt0\\''"]|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2})'
  escaped_char: '\\([nrt0\\''"]|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u\{[0-9a-fA-F]{1,6}\})'
  int_suffixes: '[iu](?:8|16|32|64|128|size)'
  float_suffixes: 'f(?:32|64)'
  dec_literal: '[0-9](?:[0-9_])*'
  float_exponent: '[eE][+-]?[0-9_]*[0-9][0-9_]*'
  primitives: '(?:bool|char|str|f32|f64|i8|i16|i32|i64|i128|isize|u8|u16|u32|u64|u128|usize|Self)'
contexts:
  main:
    - include: statements

  prototype:
    - include: comments

  statements:
    - include: visibility
    - include: attribute
    - match: '\b(mod)\s+({{identifier}})\b'
      captures:
        1: storage.type.module.rust
        2: entity.name.module.rust
    - match: '\b(fn)\b'
      scope: storage.type.function.rust
      push: fn-definition
    - match: '\b(struct)\b'
      scope: storage.type.struct.rust
      push: struct-definition
    - match: '\b(enum)\b'
      scope: storage.type.enum.rust
      push: enum-definition
    - match: '\b(union)\b'
      scope: storage.type.union.rust
      push: struct-definition
    - match: '\b(trait)\b'
      scope: storage.type.trait.rust
      push: trait-definition
    - match: '\b(impl)\b'
      scope: storage.type.impl.rust
      push: impl-definition
    - match: '\b(type)\b'
      scope: storage.type.type.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.type.rust
        - match: '({{identifier}})'
          captures:
            1: entity.name.type.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.type.rust
            - match: ';'
              scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
              pop: true
            - include: expressions
    - match: '\b(use)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.use.rust
        - match: ';'
          scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(self|super|crate)\b'
          scope: variable.language.rust
        - match: '\b(as)\b'
          scope: keyword.operator.rust
        - match: '::'
          scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - match: '\b(self|super|crate)\b'
              scope: variable.language.rust
            - match: '::'
              scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
            - match: '\*'
              scope: keyword.operator.rust
            - match: '\b(as)\b'
              scope: keyword.operator.rust
        - match: '\*'
          scope: keyword.operator.rust
        - match: '({{identifier}})(?=::)'
          captures:
            1: meta.path.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\b(extern)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
    - match: '\b(crate)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
    - include: block
    - include: expressions
    - match: ';'
      scope: punctuation.terminator.rust

  visibility:
    - match: '\b(pub)\s*(\()'
      captures:
        1: storage.modifier.rust
        2: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - match: '\)'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(crate|self|super|in)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - match: '::'
          scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\b(pub)\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.rust

  attribute:
    - match: '(#)(!?)(\[)'
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.annotation.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.annotation.rust
        3: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.annotation.rust
        - match: '\]'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '{{identifier}}(?=\s*[(=])'
          scope: variable.annotation.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.annotation.parameters.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
            - include: strings
            - include: numbers
            - match: '\('
              scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
              push:
                - match: '\)'
                  scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
                  pop: true
                - match: ','
                  scope: punctuation.separator.rust
                - include: strings
        - match: '='
          scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
        - match: '::'
          scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
        - include: strings
        - include: numbers

  comments:
    - match: '/\*[*!](?![*/])'
      scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: comment.block.documentation.rust
        - match: '\*/'
          scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
          pop: true
        - include: nested-comment
    - match: '/\*'
      scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: comment.block.rust
        - match: '\*/'
          scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
          pop: true
        - include: nested-comment
    - match: '//[!/](?!/)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: comment.line.documentation.rust
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true
    - match: '//'
      scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: comment.line.double-slash.rust
        - match: '$\n?'
          pop: true
  nested-comment:
    - match: '/\*'
      scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: comment.block.rust
        - match: '\*/'
          scope: punctuation.definition.comment.rust
          pop: true
        - include: nested-comment

  block:
    - match: '\{'
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.block.rust
        - match: '\}'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: statements

  expressions:
    - include: strings
    - include: chars
    - include: numbers
    - include: keywords
    - include: let
    - include: closure
    - include: macros
    - include: types
    - include: operators
    - include: method-call
    - include: function-call
    - include: lifetimes
    - include: group
    - include: brackets
    - match: '\b(self)\b'
      scope: variable.language.rust
    - match: '\b(super|crate)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*::)'
      captures:
        1: meta.path.rust
    - match: '::'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
    - match: '\.'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.dot.rust
      push:
        - match: '([0-9]+)'
          captures:
            1: constant.numeric.integer.decimal.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*\()'
          captures:
            1: support.function.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(await)\b'
          scope: keyword.control.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
          pop: true
        - match: ''
          pop: true
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust

  group:
    - match: '\('
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
        - match: '\)'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: expressions
        - include: block
  brackets:
    - match: '\['
      scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
        - match: '\]'
          scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: ';'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - include: expressions
        - include: block

  keywords:
    - match: '\b(if|else|for|in|while|loop|match|return|break|continue|yield|await)\b'
      scope: keyword.control.rust
    - match: '\b(as)\b'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\b(mut|const|static|ref|move|unsafe|async|dyn|where|default)\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.rust
    - match: '\b(true|false)\b'
      scope: constant.language.rust
    - match: '\b(impl)\b'
      scope: storage.type.impl.rust
    - match: '\b(fn)\b'
      scope: storage.type.function.rust
      push: fn-definition

  let:
    - match: '\b(let)\b'
      scope: storage.type.rust
      push:
        - match: '(?=[;=:])'
          pop: true
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          set:
            - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*=\s*\|)'
              captures:
                1: entity.name.function.rust
              pop: true
            - match: '(?=[;=:])'
              pop: true
            - match: '\b(mut|ref)\b'
              scope: storage.modifier.rust
            - include: group
            - include: brackets
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
            - match: '\b(self)\b'
              scope: variable.language.rust
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '(?=\S)'
              pop: true

  closure:
    - match: '(\|)(?=[^|]*\|)'
      scope: punctuation.definition.parameters.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.closure.rust
        - match: '\|'
          scope: punctuation.definition.parameters.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '\b(mut|ref)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '({{identifier}})'
          captures:
            1: variable.parameter.rust
        - match: ':'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
          push:
            - match: '(?=[,|])'
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: ','
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust

  macros:
    - match: '({{identifier}})(!)(?=\s*[\(\[\{])'
      scope: support.macro.rust

  method-call: []

  function-call:
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*\()'
      captures:
        1: meta.function-call.rust

  types:
    - match: '\b{{primitives}}\b'
      scope: storage.type.rust
    - match: '\b(Vec|String|Option|Result|Box|Rc|Arc|HashMap|HashSet|BTreeMap|BTreeSet|VecDeque|Some|None|Ok|Err|Copy|Clone|Debug|Default|Send|Sync|Sized|Iterator|IntoIterator|Fn|FnMut|FnOnce|Drop|PartialEq|Eq|PartialOrd|Ord|Hash|From|Into|AsRef|AsMut|Display|Error|ToString|Cell|RefCell|Mutex|RwLock|Path|PathBuf|Cow|Pin|Future|Write|Read|BufRead|Deref|DerefMut|Borrow|TryFrom|TryInto|ToOwned|Any|Unpin)\b'
      scope: support.type.rust
    - match: '<'
      scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
        - match: '>'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - include: numbers
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\b(fn)\b'
          scope: storage.type.function.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '{{identifier}}'

  type-punctuation:
    - match: '::'
      scope: punctuation.accessor.rust
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - match: '[&*]'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\+'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '='
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust

  lifetimes:
    - match: '{{lifetime}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.lifetime.rust

  operators:
    - match: '=>'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '\b_\b'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '(?:\+|-|\*|/|%|\^|&|\||<<|>>)='
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
    - match: '=='
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '!='
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '(?<![-=<>])=(?![=>])'
      scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
    - match: '&&|\|\|'
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.rust
    - match: '!'
      scope: keyword.operator.logical.rust
    - match: '<=|>=|<|>'
      scope: keyword.operator.comparison.rust
    - match: '\.\.=?'
      scope: keyword.operator.range.rust
    - match: '\+|-|\*|/|%'
      scope: keyword.operator.arithmetic.rust
    - match: '&|\||\^|<<|>>'
      scope: keyword.operator.bitwise.rust
    - match: '\?'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '@'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust

  numbers:
    - match: '\b({{dec_literal}})(\.)(?!\.|[A-Za-z_])'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push:
        - match: '[0-9][0-9_]*(?:{{float_exponent}})?'
          scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
          set:
            - match: '{{float_suffixes}}'
              scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
              pop: true
            - match: ''
              pop: true
        - match: ''
          pop: true
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}{{float_exponent}}'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push: float-suffix
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}(?={{float_suffixes}})'
      scope: constant.numeric.float.rust
      push: float-suffix
    - match: '\b0x[0-9a-fA-F_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.hexadecimal.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b0o[0-7_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.octal.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b0b[01_]+'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.binary.rust
      push: int-suffix
    - match: '\b{{dec_literal}}'
      scope: constant.numeric.integer.decimal.rust
      push: int-suffix
  int-suffix:
    - match: '{{int_suffixes}}'
      scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
      pop: true
    - match: ''
      pop: true
  float-suffix:
    - match: '{{float_suffixes}}'
      scope: storage.type.numeric.rust
      pop: true
    - match: ''
      pop: true

  chars:
    - match: '(b)?('')(?:{{escaped_byte}}|[^''\\])('')'
      scope: string.quoted.single.rust
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        3: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
    - match: '('')(?:{{escaped_char}}|[^''\\])('')'
      scope: string.quoted.single.rust
      captures:
        1: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust

  strings:
    - match: '(b)?(r)(#*)(")'
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: storage.type.string.rust
        3: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
        4: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.quoted.double.raw.rust
        - match: '"\3'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: format-placeholders
    - match: '(b)?(")'
      captures:
        1: storage.type.string.rust
        2: punctuation.definition.string.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: string.quoted.double.rust
        - match: '"'
          scope: punctuation.definition.string.end.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '{{escaped_char}}'
          scope: constant.character.escape.rust
        - match: '\\\n'
          scope: constant.character.escape.rust
        - include: format-placeholders
  format-placeholders:
    - match: '\{\{|\}\}'
      scope: constant.character.escape.rust
    - match: '\{[^{}"]*\}'
      scope: constant.other.placeholder.rust

  # ---- definitions ----
  fn-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.function.rust
      set: fn-after-name
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true
  fn-after-name:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '<'
      scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
        - match: '>'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\('
      scope: punctuation.section.parameters.begin.rust
      set: fn-parameters
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true
  fn-parameters:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - meta_content_scope: meta.function.parameters.rust
    - match: '\)'
      scope: punctuation.section.parameters.end.rust
      set: fn-return
    - match: '\b(mut)\b'
      scope: storage.modifier.rust
    - match: '&'
      scope: keyword.operator.rust
    - match: '{{lifetime}}'
      scope: storage.modifier.lifetime.rust
    - match: '\b(self)\b'
      scope: variable.parameter.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:(?!:))'
      captures:
        1: variable.parameter.rust
    - match: ':'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
      push:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.parameters.rust
        - match: '(?=[,)])'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '\['
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\]'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: numbers
            - match: ';'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: ','
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
    - include: group
  fn-return:
    - meta_scope: meta.function.rust
    - match: '->'
      scope: punctuation.separator.rust
      push:
        - meta_content_scope: meta.function.return-type.rust
        - match: '(?=\{|;|\bwhere\b)'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
          scope: storage.modifier.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
        - match: '\['
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
            - match: '\]'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: numbers
            - match: ';'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\b(where)\b'
      scope: keyword.other.rust
      push:
        - match: '(?=\{|;)'
          pop: true
        - include: types
        - include: type-punctuation
        - include: lifetimes
        - match: '{{identifier}}'
    - match: '\{'
      scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.function.rust meta.block.rust
        - match: '\}'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
          pop: true
        - include: statements
    - match: ';'
      scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
      pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  struct-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.struct.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: '\b(where)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: visibility
            - include: attribute
            - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:)'
              captures:
                1: variable.other.member.rust
            - match: ':'
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
              push:
                - match: '(?=[,}])'
                  pop: true
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - include: lifetimes
                - include: group
                - include: brackets
                - match: '\b(dyn|impl|mut)\b'
                  scope: storage.modifier.rust
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '\('
          scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust meta.group.rust
            - match: '\)'
              scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
              set:
                - meta_scope: meta.struct.rust
                - match: ';'
                  scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
                  pop: true
                - match: '(?=\S)'
                  pop: true
            - include: visibility
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: ';'
          scope: punctuation.terminator.rust
          pop: true
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  enum-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.enum.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.enum.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: attribute
            - match: '\('
              scope: punctuation.section.group.begin.rust
              push:
                - meta_scope: meta.group.rust
                - match: '\)'
                  scope: punctuation.section.group.end.rust
                  pop: true
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - include: lifetimes
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '\{'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
              push:
                - meta_scope: meta.block.rust
                - match: '\}'
                  scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
                  pop: true
                - match: '({{identifier}})(?=\s*:)'
                  captures:
                    1: variable.other.member.rust
                - match: ':'
                  scope: punctuation.separator.rust
                - match: ','
                  scope: punctuation.separator.rust
                - include: types
                - include: type-punctuation
                - match: '{{identifier}}'
            - match: '='
              scope: keyword.operator.assignment.rust
            - include: numbers
            - match: ','
              scope: punctuation.separator.rust
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  trait-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust
    - match: '({{identifier}})'
      captures:
        1: entity.name.trait.rust
      set:
        - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust
        - match: '<'
          scope: punctuation.definition.generic.begin.rust
          push:
            - meta_scope: meta.generic.rust
            - match: '>'
              scope: punctuation.definition.generic.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '{{identifier}}'
        - match: ':'
          scope: punctuation.separator.rust
          push:
            - match: '(?=\{|\bwhere\b)'
              pop: true
            - include: types
            - include: type-punctuation
            - include: lifetimes
            - match: '({{identifier}})'
              captures:
                1: entity.other.inherited-class.rust
        - match: '\b(where)\b'
          scope: keyword.other.rust
        - match: '\{'
          scope: punctuation.section.block.begin.rust
          set:
            - meta_scope: meta.trait.rust meta.block.rust
            - match: '\}'
              scope: punctuation.section.block.end.rust
              pop: true
            - include: statements
        - match: '(?=\S)'
          pop: true
    - match: '(?=\S)'
      pop: true

  impl-definition:
    - meta_scope: meta.impl.rust
    - match: '<'
